name: Kinu Kimono
description: An elegant, restrained store theme for a small kimono rental and dressing house in Kyoto, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Silk-mist pages, washi-ivory panels and ink text, deep plum for the menu rail, the dressing panels and the footer, and antique gold kept to hairlines, hooks and small marks; Zen Old Mincho for headings and Zen Kaku Gothic New for text. A vertical menu rail on the right edge in Japanese-style vertical type, a home page built around a sideways-scrolling kimono rack of rental plans that hang from a gold rail (scroll-snap, keyboard and touch scrollable, still for those who ask for less motion), the steps of a rental day, the dressing service, the journal, and a photo-strip footer over the plum colophon. Pages for home, plans, how it works (steps and dressing), the shop, about, the journal, a seasonal letter and contact, plus shop, product, cart, checkout, account, order confirmation and product search templates (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the plan rack and bookings go by phone or email). The house address and hours, the rack of plans with its prices and badge, and the footer photo strip live in three synced patterns, so each is edited once.
deviation: Planned as an ornate, festive look with #3B1F4E, #E8B04A and #F4E9F2. Changed at the user's request (elegant, restrained, refined Japanese; no bright colours, no poster look): the bright gold is muted to antique gold #B8924A and kept to hairlines, the rack rail, hooks and small marks (#7E6230 for gold text on light grounds, AA), the ground is silk mist #F4EEF2 with washi ivory #FBF8F3 panels and ink #221A28 text; style tags are elegant + traditional instead of ornate + festive. Fonts (Zen Old Mincho + Zen Kaku Gothic New) and header, footer and layout codes are as planned (H11, F8, L4; the combination is unused).
